sessions.title: Foundations of strategy
sessions.intro: Why do some firms outperform others? Start with industry position and internal capabilities, then examine how strategies are designed, planned, learned and revised.
takeaways: Separate industry attractiveness from a firm's ability to compete.
Understand the assumptions behind the six strategy schools.
Connect competitive positioning to the activities and resources that support it.

sessions.title: Business model innovation
sessions.intro: Understand how a business creates and captures value, why its model becomes vulnerable, and how technology, management, organization and co-creation support change.
takeaways: Read the warning signs before financial performance deteriorates.
Distinguish replication, renewal and dual focus.
Match the transformation route to the organization's capabilities and context.

sessions.title: Corporate scope & growth
sessions.intro: Decide which businesses, value-chain stages and geographies belong within the firm. Evaluate entry, growth and exit through a clear value-creation logic.
takeaways: Define the horizontal, vertical and geographical scope of the firm.
Test industry attractiveness, entry costs and the better-off proposition.
Compare internal development, alliances, acquisitions and divestiture.

sessions.title: Managing the portfolio
sessions.intro: Examine how a corporate parent creates value across businesses, allocates resources and organizes the trade-off between synergy and responsiveness.
takeaways: Specify the source of synergy and the cost of achieving it.
Choose parenting roles and portfolio tools that fit the decision.
Align structure with relatedness and international strategy.

sessions.title: Analysis, ecosystems & alliances
sessions.intro: Build a grounded strategic diagnosis, then extend the lens beyond firm and industry boundaries to complementary actors and cooperative arrangements.
takeaways: Use internal and external analysis as inputs to SWOT.
Map the activities, actors, positions and links behind a value proposition.
Understand alliance forms, partner selection and post-formation dynamics.

sessions.title: Strategic renewal
sessions.intro: Study how organizations renew their direction and capabilities while balancing today's business with exploration of tomorrow's opportunities.
takeaways: Distinguish exploitation from exploration and recognize both traps.
Understand ambidexterity and the roles of management in renewal.
